title: A slender East Asian woman in her early
prompt:
A slender East Asian woman in her early twenties, featuring a delicate oval face with soft cheekbones, natural fine eyebrows, and a graceful long neck. Her dark hair is neatly swept back into a relaxed bun at the rear. She reclines comfortably in a bathtub, holding a sleek smartphone in one hand with a tranquil, contemplative downward gaze.

In a soothing morning bath, her bare shoulders and collarbone subtly visible above the water level, skin glistening with fine condensation droplets. A lower body are completely naturally obscured beneath milky translucent bathwater, dense swirling steam, and brilliant white sunlight reflections, providing elegant natural occlusion without clothing or towels.

Medium close-up shot captured from slightly above the bathtub rim. She leans gently against the tub's edge, holding the phone in one hand. Thick water vapor and steam crawl across the surface of the bathwater, creating a layered atmospheric filter. Strong diagonal composition leading from her inclined head down to the smartphone.

Set in a minimalist editorial bathroom bathed in dazzling morning sunlight streaming through a large frosted window. Intense white light fills the room and creates bright specular reflections across the water surface. Rising steam catches the sunbeams, generating subtle lens flare and soft highlight bloom throughout the space.

Shot on 120 medium format camera with Kodak Portra 400 film, 80mm lens at f/2.8. Shallow depth of field focused sharply on her face and smartphone, with soft background falloff. Gentle highlight roll-off and authentic analog film grain texture. Aspect ratio 2:3.

Negative: clothes, clothing, swimsuit, underwear, towel, catalog flatness, generic posing, symmetrical stiffness, floating hands, extra limbs, extra fingers, anatomical distortion, awkward overlap, watermark, text, logo, heavy airbrushing, plastic skin, doll-like skin
